row: Marjorie Brook, LMT - massage therapist, author, international educator and creator of the Scar Tissue Release and Integrated Therapies (S.T.R.A.I.T Method™). Marjorie is here to help you care for the entire body with holistic healing techniques. On this channel Marjorie shares  educational and informational videos on massage, S.T.R.A.I.T. Method Scar Tissue Release Therapy, Integrated Therapeutic Stretching™ (I.T.S), and vibroacoustic therapy (VAT) as well as instructional video clips, interviews and seminar clips from Brook Seminars.
